notes.title: Deadville v1.0 Multiplayer
notes.content:
Surviving alone is incredibly challenging, but Deadville offers a gripping multiplayer mode, enabling players to team up with friends or strangers in a cooperative survival experience. Communication and teamwork are essential for survival as players work together to achieve common goals and protect each other from the horrors lurking in the Deadville.

- Added multiplayer support
- Play together on LAN
- Play together with Steam friends
